operators.name: pixel_unshuffle_custom

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [N, C, H, W] where H and W are divisible by r

semantics: Permutes and reshapes input tensor: output[b, c*r^2 + i*r + j, h, w] = input[b, c, h*r + i, w*r + j].
No bias or broadcasting involved; direct rearrangement.
Returns a new contiguous tensor on CUDA; input is not modified.
The operation is performed on CUDA; if input is on CPU, it will be moved to CUDA by the launcher.
Applies pixel_unshuffle with downscale factor self.upscale_factor (which is 2 in the reference).
Input x is a batch of images with shape [N, C, H, W]; output shape is [N, C*r^2, H/r, W/r].
The output tensor is returned as-is from the forward method.
Values are rearranged as described; no numerical computation is performed.
